title: Balancing External vs. Internal Validity: An Application of Causal Forest in Finance
eligible_reason: No staggered DiD. The application (Section 5) is a causal forest on the Chava-Roberts covenant-violation discontinuity: bind = 1(min_slack < 0), a non-absorbing state that turns on and off as a firm's net-worth covenant slack crosses zero (2 Different samples/NWallnoloan*.R line 72). Table 7 regresses investment on bind with gvkey and year-quarter FE as an OLS/RDD benchmark, adding controls and polynomials in the running variable (slack ratio) in columns 2-6, interactions with bind (Panel B) and a bandwidth restriction (Panel C). This is a panel regression-discontinuity design, not a staggered adoption. Parts 1-2 are Monte Carlo simulations. The Table 7 analysis sample is also not shipped.
design_notes: Part_3/3 RDD Code/Table_7_Panel_A.R: felm(`Investment/Capital win` ~ bind | factor(gvkey) + factor(yrq)); col 1 (no controls) -1.22 (0.09), N = 42,439 (output/Table_7_Panel_A.tex); cols 2-6 add lag Macro q, Cash Flow, Log(Assets) and slack-ratio polynomials. Table_7_Panel_C.R repeats within a bandwidth around the threshold. Table 6 is an RDD (rdd/rdrobust). Causal forest (grf 1.1.0, 4 Estimate causal forests/NWallnoloan_cf.R) with Y = investment, W = bind, LASSO-estimated firm FE as a covariate.
n_eligible_specs_note: No staggered binary treatment; panel RDD.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Treatment is a threshold-crossing state that switches on and off; no adoption cohorts.
data_access: proprietary (Compustat fundq/funda and Dealscan via WRDS); public covenant-violation and link files from Michael Roberts' site, CPI
data_files_note: The Table 7 regression sample (Samples/NWallnoloan.Rdata) is not shipped; README_Part_3 says Compustat and Dealscan are omitted as proprietary. The shipped forest-data file is the causal-forest sample (complete cases on forest covariates, investment not scaled by 100, plus LASSO firm FE and forest predictions; per NWallnoloan_cf.R lines 87-161), not the Table 7 sample.
software_notes: R 4.3.2: lfe, grf 1.1.0, rdd, rdrobust, glmnet.
priority_note: Not eligible (panel RDD / causal forest); regression sample not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Loading the shipped .Rdata files in R was blocked in this session, so their contents are inferred from the code that writes them. Even if bind were read as a switching binary treatment (drop post-switch-off periods), the paper frames it as an RDD and the regression sample is missing.
